Definition: from the base of G4008 (through the idea of piercing); a test, i.e. attempt, experience:--assaying, trial.
BiblicalUsage: Peira is a trial, an attempt, an experience. By faith Israel passed through the Red Sea, which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned, and others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, of bonds and imprisonment.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same sea that saves the faithful drowns the proud: trial proves whose faith is real.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
